description:
Cast Changeling Titan by paying {4}{G}.
Changeling Titan enters the battlefield, championing Bloodline Necromancer.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Changeling Titan.
Changeling Titan dies, causing Bloodline Necromancer to return to the battlefield from exile.
Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, returning Changeling Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities, causing you to scry 1 an infinite number of times.
